notes: ADR-0270 exact-expiry panel SOURCE for the strike screen: this document exists ONLY to materialize the 118-name exact-expiry panel through the HPO owner's panel cache, `python -m index_options.cdf_study CONFIG --stage panel` (run from children/index_options). It never runs search, select, evaluate or report: the screen's fits are the two CDFExperiment documents run-strike-screen-fits-L1.json and run-strike-screen-fits-L3.json (execution-path decision in docs/architecture/decision-log.md). The panel stage writes <experiment.output>/panel-cache/frame.parquet and record.json (ParquetFrameCache; PANEL_CACHE_DIR and ParquetFrameCache.FRAME name them): THE CACHED FRAME'S PARQUET PATH AND SHA256 (record.json frame_sha256, equal to the file's sha256) ARE WHAT THE FIT DOCUMENTS PIN as panel and panel_sha256, and what run-strike-region-scores*.json read. The panel stage refuses a context column, so data.decision_regions is absent (it is the only difference from the earlier arms document, b3050f4f); the strike-level contexts are scored afterwards from the converter's chain archive by StrikeRegionScores. Everything else is kept as it was so the panel columns (279 feature names in study.features; the arms of the fit documents read the first 42 and the first 161 of them, the 118 symbol one-hots are appended by the experiment queue itself) are exactly what the arms document pinned: tests/test_strike_screen_panel_source.py still enforces every protocol pin it can and constructs the real CDFHyperparameterStudy on this document. The study, candidates and experiment blocks below are retained only because the panel stage constructs the HPO owner on the whole document before it reads; their candidates are never trained. search, select and evaluate are refused by the empty experiment.expected_cells (an unresolved census) and must never be run on this document; the stage is --stage panel only. FIT BUDGET IS ZERO until the registration is approved; every manifest_sha256 is a 64-zero placeholder the store refuses until onboarding resolves it (documents/study/README.md in the pilot root has the invocation order).

data.notes: Sources are registered in the pilot-root onboarding store ($ROOT/ob) from the converter outputs: theta-exact-expiry-tables (surface.parquet, lifecycle.parquet), theta-exact-expiry-archive (the archive tree: read by the raw-chain prepare stage and by the decision contexts), theta-raw-chain-features (the prepare stage output with its .sources.json sidecar), theta-prices-index-daily and theta-own-iv-index-daily (localtables index_daily streams: price_source and iv_source; symbols maps every name to its OWN own_iv series, in VIX-style points). price_source and iv_source name a source and have no manifest pin knob: their identity rides in the panel provenance (reader fingerprints). raw_chain: nodes 9, moneyness_bounds +-0.3 and max_node_gap 0.04 are run-predictive-cdf-risk-neutral.json's; proxy_probabilities (19 levels), min_wing_nodes 5, max_inner_gap 0.05 and max_outer_gap 0.10 are the proxy defaults proposed in docs/research/distribution-modeling/2026-10-18-market-implied-reference-and-baselines.md item 6 (its min_forward_pairs 5 is not a RawChainFeatureBuilder knob). keyed_tables: the four vl_ features read the existing universe-liquidity-20261008 source of the main store (volume22 and volume66 streams, max_age_days 0). dividend_field is absent: the label is the protocol's split-adjusted close return, dividends known zero. decision_regions is deliberately absent: the panel stage refuses a context column and the strike-level contexts are built later from the chain archive by StrikeRegionScores (its listed_strikes block).

study.notes: features = 42 price/calendar columns (protocol inputs.sequence + inputs.context) + own_iv + 118 chain columns (10 surface scalars, 85 RawChainFeatureBuilder columns, 4 panel rn_ shape columns, 19 surface dynamics) + 118 symbol one-hots = 279; own_iv is derived from the same chain, so it travels with the chain arm only. The decision_context and wing_metrics keys are retained for the HPO owner's construction of the L3 candidates; the panel stage never builds a context. tail_weight is not declared here (the HPO owner refuses tail_crps training under a decision_context). fold_table: the protocol's screen rows (configs/strike-screen-folds-screen.jsonl, sha256 pinned, resolved against the working directory children/index_options); cal_n 82 is the protocol's value (40 + ceil(252*60/365)). models: the references only. calibrate is false on every candidate (the owner refuses a calibration map on rows that steer patience).

experiment.notes: Panel materialization only: experiment.output is the HPO owner's panel cache root, so the cached frame lands at <output>/panel-cache/frame.parquet. The 8 candidates below (2 arms x 2 encoders x 2 losses, the earlier arms study) are kept so the HPO owner can construct this document and are NEVER trained here: do not run --stage search, select, evaluate or report on it. The trained candidates are the CDFExperiment documents'. The panel stage takes no --partition. expected_cells stay unresolved (a census of the built panel is not needed to materialize it). Caps (protocol): 14400 s wall in total, 1e9 output bytes, 8 GiB host RSS increment, 12 GiB VRAM, one GPU process, no retries; enforced by the invocation, not by this document.
